title: Toward Postural State Classification in Immersive VR with Multimodal Data and Explainability Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.28844v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensuring a safe virtual reality (VR) experience requires systems that can predict and respond when users lose their balance. Although prior work has examined fall prediction and motion sickness, many approaches are regression-based and postural state classification remains less explored. This study compares machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for classifying postural states in VR under visual perturbations. We used a multimodal dataset containing kinematic, electromyographic (EMG), and electrodermal activity (EDA) signals. The data were prepared for a binary task to distinguish balanced from imbalanced postural states, and participant-wise downsampling addressed class imbalance. All models were evaluated with Leave-One-Participant-Out (LOPO) cross-validation to test generalization to unseen participants. translated_title: 基于多模态数据与可解释性分析的沉浸式VR姿势状态分类研究
translated_abstract: 确保安全的虚拟现实（VR）体验需要能够在用户失去平衡时进行预测和响应的系统。尽管先前的研究已经探讨了跌倒预测和晕动症问题，但许多方法基于回归，姿势状态分类仍然较少被研究。本研究比较了机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型，用于在视觉扰动下对VR中的姿势状态进行分类。我们使用了包含运动学、肌电（EMG）和皮电活动（EDA）信号的多模态数据集。数据被准备用于二分类任务，以区分平衡与不平衡的姿势状态，并采用按参与者降采样的方式解决类别不平衡问题。所有模型均采用留一参与者交叉验证（LOPO）进行评估，以测试对未见参与者的泛化能力。在所有模型中，受Mamba启发的CNN（MI-CNN）达到了96.76%的最高准确率。研究还使用SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）方法进行可解释性分析。
tldr: 该研究利用包含运动学、肌电和皮电信号的多模态数据，比较多种机器学习与深度学习模型对VR中视觉扰动下的姿势状态进行二分类，其中受Mamba启发的CNN（MI-CNN）达到96.76%的最高准确率，并通过SHAP提供可解释性分析。
en_tdlr: This study compares ML and DL models using multimodal data (kinematics, EMG, EDA) to classify balanced vs. imbalanced postural states in immersive VR under visual perturbations, with a Mamba-inspired CNN achieving the highest accuracy of 96.76% and explainability analysis via SHAP.
